cards.text: Friend, Jesus just took the little daughter of Jairus, a synagogue leader, by the hand and told her to get up. And she GOT UP. Now Jesus moves on from there, and His disciples come along with Him.

cards.question: Jesus and His disciples are on the move again. Where does Jesus go next?

cards.text: Then the Sabbath comes, and Jesus starts teaching in the synagogue. Hometown crowd, friend, and I bet half that room remembers Him from when He was knee-high.

cards.question: Jesus teaches in His hometown synagogue on the Sabbath, and many who hear Him are ___.
The hometown crowd starts asking where Jesus got His ideas and His wisdom.

cards.text: Then the questions get personal. Nothing humbles you like the folks who knew you back when: I came back renewed with a FULL mustache, and I bet the dead batteries I shared that drawer with would STILL call me the dusty stamper.

cards.question: The hometown crowd knows exactly what Jesus did for work. What do they call Him?
The hometown crowd knows Jesus' family too. They call Him the son of ___.
The hometown crowd names four of Jesus' brothers: James, Joses, Judas and Simon.

cards.text: Astonished at the wisdom. Astonished at the miracles. And STILL, to them He's the carpenter whose sisters are right there in town with them.

cards.question: The hometown crowd is astonished by Jesus' wisdom and miracles, but they know Him as the local carpenter. How do they end up responding to Him?

answers.text: They ask Him to stay longer
They follow Him to the next town

cards.text: Then Jesus speaks to them about how a prophet gets treated. And friend, He doesn't have to look far for an example.

cards.question: Standing in His hometown, Jesus says a prophet is without honor everywhere he goes.

cards.text: So in His own hometown, Jesus could not perform any miracles there. Well... except one thing.

cards.question: In His hometown, Jesus could not perform any miracles except one thing. What does He do?

answers.text: He lays hands on a few sick and heals them
He drives demons out of a man in town
He calms a storm out on the sea

cards.question: Jesus sees the unbelief in His hometown, and He is ___ at it.
After all that unbelief in His hometown, what does Jesus do next?

answers.text: He goes from village to village teaching
He goes up a mountain alone to pray
He sails back across the sea to rest

findings.problem: Card 1 retells Jesus raising Jairus' daughter. That fact comes from the previous passage (Mark 5:41-42), but the card cites only Mark 6:1 and gives no reference for it.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: The statement says the crowd asks where Jesus got His wisdom. In the text, 'where' is asked only about His ideas. About His wisdom they ask 'What is this wisdom He has been given?' The card also leaves out their question about His miracles.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: The true or false card asks the baker to confirm four brothers' names that no earlier card mentioned. Nothing earlier lets the baker reason about the list, so the answer is pure luck. It is also the third question in a row about family and work details in verse 3.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: Card 10 mostly recaps verses 2 and 3, which were already covered ('Astonished at the wisdom. Astonished at the miracles... the carpenter'). The only new detail is the sisters, so the card doesn't move the passage forward.

Jesus' actual saying in verse 4 is never told on any card. Card 12 calls it only 'how a prophet gets treated', and card 13 only rules out 'everywhere he goes'. The baker never learns that a prophet is without honor in his hometown, among his relatives and in his own household, which is the key line of the passage.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: The question places the action 'In His hometown', and the wrong answer 'He calms a storm out on the sea' happens out on the sea. The question's own setup rules it out.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
